Designated Employers

Employers who wish to utilize the Atlantic Immigration Program (AIP) must be designated by the Office of Immigration and Multiculturalism (OIM) by meeting certain requirements, including a commitment to support newcomers and their families as they integrate into their new life in Atlantic Canada.

Upon designation, employers can then forward applications from international workers to OIM to be endorsed, entitling the worker to apply for a work permit and/or permanent residency.

This is a list of OIM-designated employers under the Atlantic Immigration Program (AIP). This table will be updated on a regular basis.

Please note: “o/a” is an abbreviation for “operating as”. “NAICS” is an abbreviation for North American Industry Classification System and has been developed by the statistical agencies of Canada, Mexico and the United States to classify businesses according to sector. “NOC” is an abbreviation for National Occupational Classification system and is used to classify jobs based on the type of job duties and work a person does.

About the Department

The Department of Jobs, Immigration and Growth has a mandate to ensure the province has skilled workers for a fast-growing economy. This includes creating a climate which is conducive to economic growth, competitiveness and prosperity. This will be achieved through a spectrum of programs, services, and supports.
